description: This file defines a Java interface 'AuthenticatorRepository' extending JpaRepository for managing 'Authenticator' entities. It includes custom query methods for finding authenticators by credential ID and user ID.

classes.name: AuthenticatorRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for 'Authenticator' entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByCredentialId
methods.description: Finds an Authenticator by its credential ID.

methods.name: findByUser_Id
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Authenticators associated with a specific user ID.
